scope: SessionStore durable cleanup lock span, revision validation, retained/cleanup IDs and Windows junction root authority

regressions.reproduction: ADE_SESSION_CLEANUP_BEFORE reconstructs the previous MainWindow save/callback/save sequence against real SessionStore I/O. This is a behavioral reconstruction, not a binary built from an old repository commit.
regressions.observed: A second store saved the deleted chat as retained during the cleanup callback. Its owned fixture file was already deleted before the final stale-revision save failed.
regressions.fixed: processPendingCleanup holds the same sessions.lock through validated initial persistence, cleanup callbacks and final remaining-marker commit.

regressions.observed: QFileInfo::canonicalFilePath returned the junction alias on this Windows/Qt build. Ordinary save accepted a retargeted alias with identical sessions.json; unchanged and during-retarget cleanup fixtures also failed their expected behavior.
regressions.fixed: Resolve directories through GetFinalPathNameByHandleW, pin the accepted directory, and use its resolved path for locks, JSON I/O and cleanup callbacks. A retarget before operation is rejected; a retarget during callback cannot redirect that callback to the foreign fixture.

cases: Concurrent writer cannot resurrect cleanup target
Partial failure survives restart and retries only remaining IDs
Candidate retained/cleanup overlap rejects before cleanup
Invalid and case-duplicate retained/cleanup IDs reject on save/load
Identical-revision alias retarget cannot be adopted by ordinary save
During-callback retarget preserves original cleanup authority

boundedReview.result: No additional concrete defect found in the changed lock/revision/ID validation and Windows root resolution paths.
limitations: These tests cover cooperating SessionStore writers and deterministic junction retargets on this Windows build; they do not establish universal filesystem race immunity.
The callback fixture deletes only owned temporary marker files; downstream attachment/read-snapshot removal has separate suites.
Exception/restart fixtures do not establish power-loss durability or exercise every possible final-save disk failure.
Non-Windows fallback does not have the Windows directory-handle pin guarantee.
